job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

As a technical developer our AI team, work with strategic clients to help them utilize their data to take action

Stay up-to-date on the latest AI tools and features

Provide Technical solutioning for our generative AI projects

Participate in code reviews and solutioning sessions with our data scientists, ai

engineers, software engineers, and other technical resources

Lead cross-functional projects and enable collaboration across artificial intelligence and OneMagnify




What youll need:

Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university. Master's degree preferred.

Experience with Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Large Language Models- Must

Object-oriented programming experience- Must

Working knowledge of DataBricks- Must

4+ years in a technical role with experience leading projects.4+ years if educational

level is masters.

Solid understanding of data analytics and business intelligence tools such as Python, R,

SQL, Domo, Tableau, and PowerBI

Expert presentation skills

Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting

environments preferred.

Experience in Audience segmentation modelling, Agent orchestration.
